facts.fact: Connected TV (CTV) captures approximately 38% of total U.S. television advertising spend, according to IAB and eMarketer analysis cited by the page.
facts.quote: Connected TV (CTV) now captures approximately 38% of total television advertising spend in the United States

facts.fact: CTV's share of U.S. TV advertising spend was about 15% in 2020, according to the page.
facts.quote: That's up from just 15% in 2020, representing one of the fastest shifts in advertising history.

facts.fact: U.S. CTV advertising spend is about $33 billion in 2025, out of an approximately $88 billion total U.S. TV advertising market.
facts.quote: The 38% CTV share represents $33 billion of the approximately $88 billion total U.S. television advertising market in 2025.

facts.fact: Linear TV receives the remaining 62%, or roughly $55 billion, of U.S. TV advertising spend in 2025.
facts.quote: The remaining 62%, or roughly $55 billion, goes to linear television including broadcast networks and cable channels.

facts.fact: CTV's share of TV ad spend is projected to reach about 45% by 2027, or about $42 billion of $93 billion.
facts.quote: 2027 projected:** Expected to reach ~45% ($42B of $93B)

facts.fact: In 2020, CTV captured about $12 billion of an $80 billion total TV ad market.
facts.quote: 2020:** CTV captured ~15% of TV ad spend ($12B of $80B total)

facts.fact: In 2021, CTV's share of TV ad spend was about 18%, or $14 billion of $78 billion.
facts.quote: 2021:** Share grew to ~18% ($14B of $78B)

facts.quote: 2022:** CTV reached ~23% ($20B of $87B)

facts.fact: In 2024, CTV's share of TV ad spend was about 33%, or $29 billion of $88 billion.
